messages:
Diego M: Morning team, quick one — my corpcard was declined at check-in for incidental hold at the Marriott (they requested a debit). I paid the incidental hold and minibar charge on my personal card (USD 78.50) because the clerk said hotel policy. The corpcard later shows the incidental hold as `Marriott HOLD 0.00` and a separate `Marriott MINIBAR 78.50 USD`. My Concur entry has the receipt (I uploaded). Can we get reimbursed and reconcile the corpcard hold?

Finance Bot: Automated: please attach the line-item receipt and include manager approval for incidental/minibar charges. Policy excerpt: "Mini-bar and incidental holds are reimbursable when incurred due to corporate card restrictions or hotel policy that mandates debit; must be approved by manager." Link: https://intra.redwood/expenses#hotel_incidentals :information_source:

Diego M: Receipt snippet: 
```
Marriott Downtown
Room 712
Mini-bar snacks x3: $45.00
Mini-bar drinks x2: $33.50
Total charged: $78.50
Transaction ID: M-447221
Date: 2026-03-12
```
Charged to personal Citi (ending 9910). Corpcard statement shows pending hold CC-HOLD-1205 and a settled minibar CC-TXN-6741. I think vendor billed twice due to the hold.

Tara L: Approved 10 0000 0 0 (short: approve reimbursement; client workshop ran late).

Finance Bot: Next steps: submit Concur claim under category `Travel - Hotel Incidentals`, attach manager approval screenshot or forward this thread, select ACH to last4 9910. Processing ETA: 2 payroll cycles.

Elena R: Logging exception EX-2026-019. I'll open chargeback investigation for the corpcard hold vs settled charge (ticket CB-95). Diego: please confirm project code. Also confirm whether minibar consumption was client-related entertainment or personal.

Diego M: Charge to project `EXP-AW-22` (client: Wayfarer). Minibar was for client prep with on-call SM, not personal (snacks for the team).

People Ops: Noted — will add a short FAQ entry about hotels that require debit for holds to the expenses update doc. Add manager approval to the exception ticket. :pencil2:

Finance Bot: Reimbursement queued (queue id: RQ-7835). Chargeback opened (CB-95). Will update when ACH posts or chargeback resolves.

Elena R: Received all attachments. Processing now and will reply when ACH posts or if chargeback requires more info. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
